notes.title: 2.0 - Revamped imprint-X design
notes.content:
We took some time to look back at imprint-X and the games largest design-flaw, the rhythm-based bosses.
We tweaked the puzzle world design, level theming and refined some of the phasing of the game.
This patch is more true to the core gameplay and the button based puzzles.

All worlds are unlocked directly in order to allow easier puzzle switching and prevent getting stuck.
Banished all world bosses to an alternative playable world, the randomized procedural super-boss is all the rhythm-bosses the game needs.
Added a couple of unreleased never seen levels cleaned up achievements and update the game-engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25935860/6f8660002c3da8fd597744f6ce03aa3988475953.png[/img]

[b]If you like the game please leave a Steam review <3 [/b]

[i]Please use the Steam forum for feature requests, questions, or bug reports we actively monitor that.[/i]

To play the old version of the game see the "classic" beta branch in steam. 

[h3]imprint-X - 2.0.0 - Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]🌟Features & 👾Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Update Game-engine[/b]
Update Unity and 3rd party plugins to latest LTS versions.
We fixed a lot of deprecations and niched rendering bugs with this.

[*][b]New video player[/b]
Switched to a better performing and easier to use video player.

[*][b]Updated masking shader[/b]
Fixed some rendering clipping bugs.

[*][b]Update line-rendering[/b]
Update the new rendering API.

[*][b]Redesign worlds[/b]
13 new worlds with better theming. 
Made some unfair levels optional.

[*][b]Unlocked all worlds[/b]
Test the world as you want.

[*][b]Switched asset and file serialization[/b]
meta files everywhere.

[*][b]Removed mandatory rhythm bosses[/b]
Worlds are now about puzzles

[*][b]Updated in-game social media links[/b]
These now points to our current stuff..

[*][b]Cleaned up legacy objects from all levels[/b]
Simplified scenes. 

[*][b]Moved all world bosses to its own separate world[/b]
Rhythm hell all in one.

[*][b]Update Steam SDK[/b]

[*][b]Script performance fixes[/b]
Improved lots of old scripts that affected game performance.

[*][b]Add new level and unrelease levels[/b]

[*][b]Removed buggy achievements[/b]
Old world design achievements.

[*][b]Added new achievements for the new worlds to beat[/b]

[*][b]New steam cloud save file[/b]
Cleanup for the new world overview and level layouts and as well as legacy save bug fixes.

[/list]

Thank you ❤️


// Kim & Vendela

notes.title: Bit - Animation Editor is available!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25935860/e29b31eba254bf37a448deb79f31df7d8a6d18db.png[/img]

Bit - Animation Editor is finally out! Check it out it over here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1370650/Bit__Animation_Editor/
We're live right now, making some art, so come join us! =D

[previewyoutube=cHeFsk7qKSs;full][/previewyoutube]

Bit is an art tool with powerful export options, used to compose and design animated pixel art! It concentrates on composition design and simpler mechanical animations like tweening/easing. Moreover, we have a Unity importer available for it.

And here's a link to the [url=https://morgondag.io/pages/bit-documentation]manual[/url], where you can learn everything you need to get started. You can for example read about how to create a new project [url=https://morgondag.io/pages/bit-create-new-project]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25935860/4d2ca54453e809c4ad64cf8e1d0445abcfef268e.gif[/img]

Take care! <3
//Morgondag

notes.title: Help us translate Vast Void!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9319469/d40bd6f36bf5b6857d43731edd2e7befd99c1cc3.png[/img]

Hey! 

This week's [url=https://morgondag.io/blogs/morgondag/help-us-translate-vast-void]blog post[/url] is super long, containing super much stats! We present the results from the poll we ran two weeks ago. We also show you some summarizations of Steam data, done with R, where we look at the 25 countries where RymdResa were played the most in 2016, 2017 and 2018.

We've also decided to try community translations! Yay! Read more about the decision here:
[url=https://morgondag.io/blogs/morgondag/help-us-translate-vast-void]https://morgondag.io/blogs/morgondag/help-us-translate-vast-void[/url]

Want to help us translate Vast Void? Wohow!! We''re starting the first round of translations today (now). We will begin by translating the Diary Pods form RymdResa (which are the same in Vast Void) and take it from there. We have created a public google doc where people can fill in their translations and edit existing ones, you can reach it directly [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XcPgcJNFKCGOQRER3Zytu8MRsh2lzWPIyJqRUeOiG70/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url]!

We have set up translation sheets for French, German, Japanese, Italian, Korean, Polish, Portuguese-Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Swedish (we explain why we've chosen those languages in the [url=https://morgondag.io/blogs/morgondag/help-us-translate-vast-void]blog post[/url]. If you want to add another language, please let us know! =)

//Vendela

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Zz70Tl8.png[/img]

Hello everyone!! Hope you're having a magnificent day! <3 We've made a new huge imprint-X patch with some awesome new content (an entire extra world), improvements and bug-fixes.

[b]One entire new world containing 7 new levels in total:[/b]
[list]
    [*]5 new Puzzle Wardens
    [*]2 new Bosses
[/list]

[b]Furthermore we have made some improvements to imprint-X:[/b]
[list]
    [*]New button visibility mode in the options - strong green buttons for everyone! 
    [*]New brand logo for better readability and simplicity.
    [*]New toggle fps-limiter in the options.
    [*]Language selection is now displayed in each own language.
    [*]Compressed and optimized textures, audio files and other assets to reduce file-size and increase performance.
    [*]Upgraded to Unity Engine 5.6, (lots of performance and improvements).
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug with click-particles spawning an error in the background, slowing things down.
    [*]Fixed a rare issue with a button listener checking for more buttons then there are available.
    [*]Fixed a bug where victory could be triggered multiple time on the same level.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the game could crash on save-file deletion.
[/list]

[b]With your awesome help we've also detected some levels  bugs that we now have fixed:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Level free_rotation1.5 -  will no longer continue triggering after victory.
    [*]Level mover_timing3 - double clicking crown on end will no longer jump to the opposite side.
    [*]Level holddown4 -  lowered threshold for perfect moves.
    [*]Player can now get perfect scores on the following levels: holddown1, haidukon1 and attacher1.
[/list]

[b]We have also added some  new translators to the credits, thank you:[/b]
Kimo, hydr0x, codename eddy, DreadGuacamole, DnnD and Dollppin!  <3

[b]Android fix:[/b]
Change save-file write storage to internal instead of SD-Card. 

Enjoy! <3

// Kim and Vendela

[url=https://imprint-x.com][img]http://i.imgur.com/jFEmFqe.png[/img][/url]

Love,
Morgondag <3

notes.title: Help us translate imprint-X
notes.content:
We want imprint-X to be accessible for everyone. We have therefor created a game without any words in it. But we do have a Store Page with words. Words that need to be translated :)  Want to help us translate imprint-X? We have created a public google doc, where people can fill in their translations. Check it out over [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dUzQrrxf2PFmLhQdzRbi1tkYpMhz1QT6yClQ2gl2Ofo/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url] and fill in your translation! Your help is much appreciated!

Help us spread the word! <3

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dUzQrrxf2PFmLhQdzRbi1tkYpMhz1QT6yClQ2gl2Ofo/edit?usp=sharing][img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/49/48307/63.png[/img][/url]
